1084-2324-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-2324-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-2324-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

4279-5708-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5708-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

64-4113-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by tapping Warden of the Eye due to Daydream's convoke ability, blinking Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3175-8207.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

141-1893-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1893-4050.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-3362-4247-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-3362-4247-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

465-618-8095.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2111-2292-4981.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1558-3478-3875-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3478-3875-4231-7824.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

440-1786-6996-7426.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1786-6996-7426.description:
Draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain life.
Well of Lost Dreams and The Destined White Mage trigger.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2

2034-3693-5224-7692.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2173-4496-5220-5708.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-2557-2638-3478-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2557-2638-3478-4231.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

423-573-872-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-573-872-1437--85.description:
Cast Scaled Herbalist by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Scaled Herbalist spell three times.
Resolve the first Scaled Herbalist copy.
Activate the Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

944-1020-2866-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Planar Gate.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Planar Gate.
Repeat.

114-3263-7061.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3263-7061.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

593-1640-4083.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Mogg Maniac.
Mogg Maniac is indestructible.
593-1640-4083.description:
Deal damage to Mogg Maniac.
Mogg Maniac and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Mogg Maniac trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Mogg Maniac instead of you due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

4067-5672-6071.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5672-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
4067-5672-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping The Core.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-2292-4321-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2292-4321-6351.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.

1429-4452-5226-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4452-5226-5402.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1679-2302-4963-5231.notablePrerequisites:
"Blue" chosen with Painter's Servant.
You have a way to draw a card.
1679-2302-4963-5231.description:
Activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Draw a card, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token instead.
When the Bear token enters the battlefield, Dire Undercurrents' first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Bear token, adding {R}.
Activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Resolve the Dire Undercurrents trigger from step 3, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1778-3156-3558-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Crookshank Kobolds.
1778-3156-3558-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, targeting Memnite.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Memnite.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Memnite, targeting Crookshank Kobolds.
When Memnite dies, Koll triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

352-914-2234.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
352-914-2234.description:
Cast Baral's Expertise by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Baral's Expertise.
Resolve the copy of Baral's Expertise, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand, and casting Dockside Extortionist from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Nivix Guildmage's first ability to loot infinitely.

1323-2265-4762.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-2265-4762.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.
